Post 1
⛏️ Materials ripped +3.71% today while defensives sold off hard — the ASX 200 gained 71.40pts or +0.82% to 8,763.80. Rare earths and gold stocks led the charge. The market is not flat; it's rotating fast. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Materials +3.71%, Energy +2.67% dominated. Consumer Staples dropped -1.36%, the worst sector. Classic risk-on rotation — cyclicals in, defensives out. The spread between top and bottom sectors hit over 5%. #ASX #mining #energy

Post 3
🟢 LYC surged +7.89% to AUD 13.81 — Lynas Rare Earths riding materials momentum hard. With China supply concerns never far away, rare earths are back in focus. One of the cleaner sector plays on the board today. #ASX #rareearths

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 5,409.60/oz. Silver AUD 62.53/oz. With the AUD/USD at 0.6637, metals priced in local currency stay elevated — a direct tailwind for ASX gold and materials names today. #gold #silver #ASX #metals

Post 5
Watch the AUD/USD 0.6637 handle. A break lower lifts local gold prices further, extending materials tailwinds. A bounce compresses them. Where do you see the AUD heading into next week — risk-on rally or fade? #ausbiz #ASX #FX
